mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Spirit Fire: Armor Debuff</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has reduced Armor.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nasus ignites a spirit flame, dealing <magicDamage>@InitialDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Enemies in the area lose <scaleArmor>@ArmorShredPercent*-100@% Armor</scaleArmor> and take <magicDamage>@TotalDotDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @Duration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Life Steal.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nasus has an additional @Spell.NasusPassive:LifestealTooltip@% Life Steal.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nasus' next Attack deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. Killing an enemy with this Attack permanently increases its damage by @BasicStacks@, increased to @BigStacks@ against champions, large minions and large jungle monsters.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
{{ buff_desc_SpellEffects }}
This Ability can critically strike for @CritDamage@ physical damage.

mBuff.mDescription:
Siphoning StrikeWhen Nasus's Siphoning Strike slays a unit, its damage permanently increases.

Current bonus damage: @f1@Source: @SourceName@

<titleLeft>Siphoning Strike</titleLeft><mainText>Nasus' next attack deals bonus damage and increases the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Fury of the Sands</titleLeft><mainText>While in this form Nasus has bonus Health, damages nearby enemies, has reduced Siphoning Strike cooldown, and gains bonus Armor and Magic Resistance (currently +@f1@ bonus).</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, damages nearby enemies, has a reduced cooldown on Siphoning Strike, and gains bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Nasus becomes empowered in the sandstorm for 15 seconds, increasing his maximum Health by @BonusHealth@ and Armor and Magic Resistance by @InitialResistGain@.

While the storm rages, nearby enemies take @DamageCalc@ of their maximum Health as magic damage each second and Siphoning Strike has a @QCDR*100@% reduced Cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The storm deals a max of @MaxDamageCap@ damage per second.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Renekton has fallen to Nasus' will. The size Renekton gains from his Ultimate Ability, Dominus, has decreased.

“What am I? Dust and blood, back in the dark?”

With Renekton's defeat, Nasus' Ultimate Ability, Fury of the Sands, now lasts longer and grants additional size.

“My brother's savagery endangered us all. The sands will soon know peace.”

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Wither</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Move and Attack Speeds are becoming increasingly slowed over time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nasus ages an enemy champion, decelerating their Move Speed and Attack Speed over time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nasus ages a champion, <status>Slowing</status> them by @SlowBase@%, increasing to @MaxSlowTooltipOnly@% over @Duration@ seconds. Their <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> is also reduced by @AttackSpeedSlowMult*100@% of the <status>Slow</status>.
